seo.title: Bethany Hamilton, RCS, CMA — Case Manager | Des Moines Wellness Center
seo.description: Meet Bethany Hamilton, RCS, CMA, Case Manager at Des Moines Wellness Center.

image.alt: Bethany Hamilton, RCS, CMA - Case Manager

sections.heading: About:
body: Bethany Hamilton serves as a Case Manager at Des Moines Wellness Center, where she is committed to helping individuals build a strong foundation for lasting recovery and long-term wellness. Bethany works closely with each client to develop personalized discharge and aftercare plans that support continued success beyond treatment.

She is passionate about ensuring every individual has access to the resources, guidance, and encouragement they need as they transition into the next stage of their recovery journey. Known for her compassionate and client-centered approach, Bethany strives to create an environment where every person feels heard, supported, empowered, and hopeful.
She is honored to be part of each client's journey and is dedicated to helping them achieve lasting healing and a brighter future.

sections.heading: Ready to Take the First Step?
body: Recovery is built on relationships. If you’re looking for help with addiction or mental health challenges, our team is here to guide you every step of the way. Contact Des Moines Wellness Center to learn more about our programs and admissions process.

sections.heading: Recovery Starts With the Right People
body: At Des Moines Wellness Center, our team is committed to providing compassionate, evidence-based care for addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions. Whether you’re looking for medical detox, residential treatment, IOP, or ongoing recovery support, we’re here to help you find the right path forward. Contact our admissions team today to learn more about treatment options, verify insurance, and take the first step toward lasting recovery.
